subject: can ggplot 2 plot correlation bubble plot?

messages.author: 8d614c9bf22b1a89
messages.subject: can ggplot 2 plot correlation bubble plot?
parts:
Hello, i am plotting a correlation bubble plot. can i use ggplot2?

sample dataset is:

options(digits=2)
x0 <- matrix(c(45,53,35,66,49,60,1.9,7.9,9.3,1.4,5.7,2.6), nrow = 6, ncol = 2)
y0 <- matrix(c(1.1,0.98,1,0.78,0.75,1.2,0.98,1.6,2.1,1.40,1.54,1.5,
               26.70,32.9,35.60,32.5,32.1,38.3,1,2.10,3.00,3.8,3.90,2.5),nrow=6,ncol=4)
cor(x0,y0)

> cor(x0,y0,use = "complete")
       [,1]  [,2] [,3] [,4]
[1,] -0.163 -0.40 0.18 0.27
[2,] -0.092  0.82 0.29 0.12

i was told by r that ggplot2 cannot handle matrix....

thanks!

messages.subject: Re: can ggplot 2 plot correlation bubble plot?
parts:
i am not sure if there is a r command to do it, but i manipulated the data and got what i want. i am posting the code here just in case someone else need it.

x <- matrix(c(45,53,35,66,49,60,1.9,7.9,9.3,1.4,5.7,2.6), nrow = 6, ncol = 2)
colnames(x) <- c("x1","x2")
y <- matrix(c(1.1,0.98,1,0.78,0.75,1.2,0.98,1.6,2.1,1.40,1.54,1.5,
               26.70,32.9,35.60,32.5,32.1,38.3,1,2.10,3.00,3.8,3.90,2.5),nrow=6,ncol=4)
colnames(y) <- c("y1","y2","y3","y4")
corr <- cor(x, y, use = "complete")
n <- nrow(corr)
m <- ncol(corr)
nx <- nrow(x)
mx <- ncol(x)
ny <- nrow(y)
my <- ncol(y)


##output p matrix

pmatrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = n, ncol = m)
for (i in 1:n){
  for (j in 1:m){
    pmatrix[i,j] = rcorr(x[,i], y[,j])$P[1,2]
  }
}


## set up variable names
rname <- rownames(corr)
cname <- colnames(corr)
options(digits=2)
new.data <- matrix(NA, nrow = n, ncol = 4)
new.x <- rep(rname, each = my)
new.y <- rep(cname, mx)
new.corr <- round(matrix(c(corr[,1],corr[,2],corr[,3],corr[,4])),2)
new.p <- round(matrix(c(pmatrix[,1],pmatrix[,2],pmatrix[,3],pmatrix[,4])),2)
new.data <- as.data.frame(cbind(new.x,new.y,new.corr,new.p))

# ggplot2 base layer
p <- ggplot(new.data)

# Bubble plots
p + geom_point(aes(x = new.x, y = new.y, size = new.corr, colour = new.p),shape=16, alpha=0.80)

messages.author: 936ef8c6d12fc338
messages.subject: RE: can ggplot 2 plot correlation bubble plot?
parts:
What about this? Starting from your x and y matrices.

 

toTest <- expand.grid(X = seq_len(ncol(x)), Y = seq_len(ncol(y)))

toTest <- cbind(toTest, t(apply(toTest, 1, function(z){

  tmp <- cor.test(x[, z["X"]], y[, z["Y"]])

  c(tmp$estimate, P = tmp$p.value)

})))

ggplot(toTest, aes(x = X, y = Y, size = abs(cor), colour = P, shape = factor(sign(cor)))) + geom_point() + scale_x_discrete() + scale_y_discrete()
